en: Hi! This is a tipbot for WojakCoin ($WJK).
You can use it to share WJK with your friends.
This bot allows you to receive, store and send WojakCoin ($WJK) on Telegram.
`/start` — Welcome (private). Deep links: `/start about`, `/start help`, `/start address`
`/scavenge` — Move funds from an old numeric-ID account to your `@username` wallet _(private; requires a username)_
`/tip` — Tip tagged users; use mentions and amounts (same amount for everyone or one amount per user).

`/rain <wjk_each> [how_many]` — Each of up to `how_many` *recently active* members gets `wjk_each` WJK (you are excluded). Total cost = `wjk_each` × (actual recipients). Omit `how_many` to include everyone eligible (up to 30).
`/checkactive` — Show how many users are in the rain activity queue.
`/pause` — Pause or resume the bot (also resets rain queues)
Need more advanced help and usage tricks?
You can't ask this in public!
